main_text.p: confirmationis salvationis munus ipsi Christo cum sanctis commune faciunt.

3. Nequaquam Christo homini, qui & verus est Deus in una persona, adimimus potestatem aeternae salutis nobis dandae, quam etiam ideo a patre accepit, quod pretium redemtionis pro nobis seipsum Deo Patri dederit, & obediens patri usque ad mortem crucis, seipsum Patri hostiam obtulerit in odore bonae fragrantiae. Christus itaque SPON-SOR & SERVATOR noster peccata nostra suo sanguine expiavit, & accepta a patre plenissima potestate in caelo & terra, nobis credentib. in novissimo illo die daturus est vitam aeternam: ipse abolita morte, omnibusque hostibus sibi subiectis, nos ab omni miseria liberatos, in societatem caelestis gloriae est adducturus.
4. Posita etiam satisfactione Christi, non efficitur, nos non agnoscere vel recte intelligere, quomodo morte & obedientia sua Christus, cunctis qui ipsi obediunt, veniam peccatorum pepe-rerit[?].

page.notes: Printed page number 281 is in italic at the top right, near a handwritten "35" that is not printed and left out. Small marks at the left edge are not legible as printed text and are left out. Small capitals in "SPONSOR & SERVATOR" are given as capitals. "pepe-rerit" at the line end: the second part is doubtful. Long s and ligatures (ct, æ, œ) are normalised as described; the u/v spelling is changed in the running head and text.
